# What's new in Plannerly

We improve Plannerly every week, and most changes start as an idea from someone who uses it. Every update is in the changelog inside the app - sign in and it opens right there, next to the Ideas board where you can vote for what comes next.

[See every update in the app](https://app.plannerly.com/projects?notification_center=ideas&ideas_view=changelog) [Start free](https://app.plannerly.com/sign-up)

Sign in and the changelog opens. New to Plannerly? Start free - no card needed.

Recently shipped

## A few recent highlights

### Duplicate a project

Start your next project from one you've already set up. Choose what comes across, and Plannerly builds the copy for you.

Projects

### Watermarks on your exports

Stamp exported documents with their status, or your own words, so nobody mistakes a draft for the final version.

Docs

### Smarter model linking rules

Link model elements to tasks with rules that say contains, starts with, ends with, greater than and more - not just equals.

Verify

Help Center

## Guides to popular features

[**COBie handover data** \\
Export your model's assets and their handover data as a COBie-ready Excel workbook.\\
Help](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/cobie-handover-data-export) [**bSDD classifications** \\
Name Scope rows from the classification standard you choose, as you type.\\
Help](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/bsdd-classifications-in-scope) [**Import and export IDS files** \\
Bring a buildingSMART IDS into Scope, refine it with your team and check models against it.\\
Help](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/import-ids-files) [**LOD and LOIN standards** \\
Set your project to ISO 19650 + LOD, LOD US BIM Forum 2022, Level of Information Need and more.\\
Help](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/project-lod-loin-standards) [**Archive instead of delete** \\
Archive document sections and tabs, find them with a filter and restore them whenever you need them.\\
Help](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/archive-document-sections-and-tabs) [**Export from any module** \\
One Export menu for PDF and Word documents, Excel data, IDS files and COBie handover files.\\
Help](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/export-files-from-any-module)

## Got an idea for Plannerly?

Share it on the Ideas board inside the app. Your team can vote and comment, and you can follow it all the way to the changelog.

[Share an idea](https://app.plannerly.com/projects?notification_center=ideas&ideas_view=ideas) [Start free](https://app.plannerly.com/sign-up)

## Bring your training from another email

Learned with a different email? Sign in to that account here and we'll bring its courses, progress and certificates into the one you're signed in with. Certificate links and QR codes keep working.
